All changes are live on the dev server. Here's what I did:

**Icons replaced (all 17 cards now have unique, material-specific icons):**
- **Inconel** → Flame (high-temperature superalloy)
- **Titanium** → Diamond gem (premium aerospace material)
- **Hastelloy** → Flask/beaker (chemical processing)
- **Monel/Rene** → Hexagonal molecule (alloy structure)
- **Carbide Inserts** → Diamond rhombus with mounting hole (turning insert shape)
- **End Mills** → Cylinder with spiral flute lines
- **Drills** → Pointed drill bit with shaft
- **Boring Bars** → Horizontal bar with cutting tip arrow
- **Tungsten Carbide Solids** → 3D cube/block (heavy material)
- **Tungsten Powder** → Scattered circles (particles/granules)
- **Pure Tungsten** → Stacked rods/bars
- **M2/M42 HSS** → Circular saw blade
- **Cobalt HSS** → Nested hexagons (crystal structure)
- **D2/A2 Die Steels** → Stamp/die press
- **Unused Tooling** → Open box
- **Plant Liquidations** → Truck (kept - already good)
- **Warehouse** → Building with door
- **Turbine Blades** → 4-blade turbine fan
- **Fasteners** → Hex bolt
- **Engine Parts** → Gear/cog

**Other changes:**
- **Carbide Inserts moved to first**, End Mills to second (no longer leads the section)
- **Tungsten section restored** (3 cards: Carbide Solids, Powder & Granules, Pure Tungsten & Heavy Alloy)
- **Aerospace stays at the bottom** (Section 6)
- **Section backgrounds alternate correctly** with the new Tungsten section inserted

Refresh http://localhost:9280/materials to see the updates.
